exercises.question: Which expression normally takes the subjunctive when expressing doubt? [¿Qué expresión normalmente lleva subjuntivo al expresar duda?]
options: No creo que [I do not think that]
Creo que [I think that]
Es evidente que [It is clear that]

exercises.sentence: No creo que la fuente __ completamente fiable. (ser) [I do not think the source is completely reliable.]

exercises.english: It is possible that the event has another explanation.

sentences: Es evidente que la noticia ha provocado una reacción. [It is clear that the news has caused a reaction.]
No creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable. [I do not think the source is completely reliable.]
Es posible que el suceso tenga otra explicación. [It is possible that the event has another explanation.]

exercises.question: Which sentence presents information as a fact? [¿Cuál presenta la información como un hecho?]
options: Es evidente que la noticia ha provocado una reacción. [It is clear that the news has caused a reaction.]
Es posible que la noticia haya provocado una reacción. [It is possible that the news has caused a reaction.]
No creo que la noticia haya provocado una reacción. [I do not think that the news has caused a reaction.]

exercises.sentence: Creo que los investigadores __ más información. (necesitar) [I think the investigators need more information.]

exercises.english: I do not think the source is completely reliable.

exercises.question: Which word means «fact»? [¿Qué palabra significa «hecho»?]
options: hecho [fact]
rumor [rumour]
reacción [reaction]

exercises.sentence: Es evidente que la noticia ha provocado una reacción inmediata.
options: It is clear that the news has caused an immediate reaction.
It is possible that the news will disappear tomorrow.
I do not think the news caused any reaction.

exercises.sentence: No creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable.
options: I do not think the source is completely reliable.
I am certain that the source is completely reliable.
The source has declared that it is reliable.

exercises.sentence: Es posible que el suceso tenga otra explicación.

options: No creo que sea completamente fiable. [I do not think it is completely reliable.]
No creo que es completamente fiable. [I do not think it is completely reliable.]
Creo que sea completamente fiable. [I think it is completely reliable.]
Sí. Es evidente que los datos coinciden. [Yes. It is clear that the data coincide.]
Sí. Es posible que los datos coincidan. [Yes. It is possible that the data coincide.]
No. Creo que los datos coincidan. [No. I think that the data coincide.]
Es posible que tenga otra explicación, pero necesitamos más datos. [It may have another explanation, but we need more data.]
Es evidente que tenga otra explicación porque no lo sabemos. [It is clear that it have another explanation because we do not know.]
No creo que tiene otra explicación. [I do not think it has another explanation.]

template.prompt: State one fact and one opinion about a news story.
template.answer: Es evidente que la noticia ha provocado una reacción, pero no creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable.

template.prompt: Evaluate a source using both certainty and doubt.
template.answer: Creo que la fuente ofrece información útil, pero no creo que sea completamente fiable.
